notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy Gunslingers. [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/983123b429846ee1f629721cef7e3acc4c44b69a.jpg[/img]
Today a new patch is coming LIVE. Thank you for all the feedback that allowed us to fix specific issues with the game.

[h2]Patch ver. 1.1[/h2]

[b]User Experience[/b]
[list]
[*]  Fixed a bug in a display mode that prevented viewing the actual resolution
[*]  Fixed incorrectly displayed area of zombie movement range while opponent movement
[*]  Fixed a bug where after completing the victory condition in 7th Mission, it only ended at the end of the turn.
[*]  Fixed a bug with pickable loot if it spawned on a gunslinger position that caused a character to take two action points to pick up the item.
[*]  Fixed the easy difficulty balance in missions 2nd, 3rd and 4th.
[*]  Fixed a bug where in some cases, the player, after reloading their weapons, could not use the Overwatch feature.
[/list]

[b]Language:[/b]
[list]
[b]Russian:[/b]
[*]  The names of the weapons have been translated
[*]  The name of the game in the mission descriptions has been translated 
[*]  Changed the font in the name of the weapon
[*]  Fixed the bug with the "Not enough action points" message not displaying
[*]  Fixed a bug that added a grey background to some characters

[b]Chinese:[/b]
[*]  Fixed an unreadable character error
[*]  Correction of 7th and 8th Mission description 
[*]  Fixed the board description for 3rd Mission 

[b]Japanese:[/b]
[*]  Fixed the error of an unreadable character in Japanese
[*]  7th and 10th Mission description fix
[*]  5th and 7th Mission introduction fix
[*]  Fixed the name of the "easy" difficulty level
[*]  Fixed the name of the 5th and 7th Mission 
[/list]

If you happen to encounter any troubles while playing Gunslingers & Zombies, please let us know!

Kind regards,
[i]Gunslingers and Zombies Team[/i]

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #46 "Running Zombies"
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy Gunslingers[/h3]

Pony Express brought some excellent news to the town.

Recently we have got inspired by the Stop Wasting My Time mod for Xcom2 and implemented some QoL solutions that allow us to adjust the speed of animations and choose if and how often the camera is changing into Action Camera mode during the fight.

From now on there will be a possibility to pick Your own tempo from the Settings menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/11bd869b26f1dd005e5380ff9aa1d38f74d40a09.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/95d9d5122b79dff41c26d8c0b69d6e15bf90926e.gif[/img]
[i]Max speed animation. Now everybody can choose his own pace.[/i]

One clever eye might notice there was no Action Camera once on the GiF above. 

We can choose how often it occurs with the Setting menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/326211befbd549138aac6382f1a0caf17202bb93.jpg[/img]

If we want, we can make run our Zombies even faster by hitting the Space button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/34f1177e4b7f6e7d09a0ef2affdb1fc766306484.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, we are preparing a patch release. There are many various changes in the game, and we couldn't keep Early Access saves integrity anymore. For this reason, we are working on adding as much content as is humanly possible for a zombie. We are preparing for a Full Release.

See You Next Friday and Best regards,
[i]Gunslingers and Zombies Team[/i]

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #44 - ”Upcoming patch”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Gunslingers![/h1]

Has it been a while, ain't it? They say as vast as Prairie is, all the roads eventually lead up to Saloon, so we have finally met again.

Today we bring some news. [b]Big news[/b]. Zombies are back, now more relentless than ever.

Soon we will introduce Big Patch to the Gunslingers & Zombies, and this day marks the day we are calling the cavalry and moving on towards Full Release.

From now on we are back to Devloging development of the game, and those Devlogs should appear every second or third Friday.

Today we would like to share a list of [b]upcoming[/b] changes with You. Currently, we are busy with playtesting this patch, and some shiny pieces of code still need to be put together.

[h3]Campaign [/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Modification of the tutorial and addition of new tutorial boards[/b] - improvements to present new mechanics and new types of zombies.

[*] [b]Creation of 6 new missions[/b] - More story, more zombies and more shooting.

[*] [b]Implementation of difficulty level[/b] - creating 3 difficulty levels: easy,
normal and hard.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/6ee13f47d477a870a0d5a81be951432def0a4327.jpg[/img]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[b]Addition of 3 new enemy classes[/b]
[list]
[*] "Hunter" Zombie, which attacks at a distance,
[*] "Boomer" Zombie, which when killed explodes with poisonous gas and deals damage friendly units (other zombies are immune),
[*] "Hub" Zombie, which after death spawns two smaller zombies of "Pocket" type,
[/list]

[b]Zombie Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now also have various amounts of Health in opposition to static 10 HP before.
[*] Zombie stats like Health, Speed or Damage now depend on chosen difficulty.
[*] Enemy Counter-attack - Adding mechanics for counter-attacking enemy units. During
attacking an enemy in melee, if the enemy is not killed, the enemy in retaliation will attack the character right after receiving damage. The mechanics will further enhance the
The mechanics will further enhance the gameplay experience and significantly influence the player's strategy,
[*] Improvement of the AI that spawns during the game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/923a9c69b2f64065de3c78e06dd1859be43f7c15.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay mechanics changes:[/h3]

[b]Adding interactive on-ground items:[/b]
[list]
[*] adding an exploding barrel which dealing area of effect damage to enemy and friendly units,
[*] adding an ammo crate, where heroes can replenish their ammo supply
[*] adding a bandages supply crate
[*] adding an explosive cart
[/list]
[b]Adding character interaction with a diagonal object:[/b]
[list]
[*] Standing diagonally from an interactive object will also be able to interact with the object.
[*] Gunslingers can also attack diagonally now.
[/list]
[b]Adding confirmation of character movement:[/b]
[list]
[*] adding a mechanic to confirm the path of a character's movement. The first LPM click marks the path the character is moving, and a second click in the same place confirms the character's movement.
[/list]
[b]Balancing changes of knife attack[/b]
[*] was a little OP. Now it's more in line with ranged weapons together with enemy HP changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/fd78544b0e06cb5a12c2a34ffe048e20bae6787e.png[/img]

[h3]Additionally[/h3]
[b]Improving the soundtrack:[/b]
[list]
[*] improving the sounds of some weapons,
[*] improving some of the sound effects that already exist in the game,
[*] adding sound effects to newly created mechanics
[/list]
[b]Modifying the UI when hovering the cursor over an enemy[/b]
[list]
[*] improving the visual effect of the UI, in which the information about the chance of
[*] damage chance and critical damage chance. Removal of zombie names and
[*] replacing them with zombie types.
[/list]
[b]Modification of the tutorial and addition of new tutorial boards[/b]
[list]
[*] improvements to present new mechanics and new types of zombies.
[/list]
[b]Introduction of several corrections and improvements, including:[/b]
[list]
[*]  changing the colour of the first movement zone,
[*]  adding an active counter-attack mode symbol to the UI,
[*]  improved ESC function,
[*]  Improved critical damage designation,
[/list]

[b]- Creation of keyboard shortcuts,[/b]

[b]- Marking the number of actions on the sidebar[/b]

[b]- Adding the ability to play in a window,[/b]

[b]- Turning off grids during the attack cutscene[/b]

[b]- Creation of new "goals," i.e. heal maximum Health, kill a zombie with a knife etc.[/b]

[b]- Some more various minor fixes[/b]

And most probably some more changes are coming soon. Right now, it's hard to estimate new updates coming live, but it's weeks, not months, shooting at the calendar.


See You Next Friday and Best regards,
[i]Gunslingers and Zombies Team[/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/WWDM2Bx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #38 - ”Stars and goals”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Gunslingers! [/h1]

[h2]There’s nothing quite like a feeling of victory. After all winning is so enjoyable and we all like to win… but there’s one thing better than winning – it’s winning in style![/h2]

[b]Think about – there are certain moments in your life when you can do bare minimum in order to somehow scrape by. Well, you can even do the least required thing and still win in something but we strongly believe that if one is to do something they should do it as close to perfect as possible. In Gunslingers & Zombies we will have a goal and stars system to check how well did you manage to defend your characters and their cities.[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/f4c4376a46e2b35c47d3c224925763da61711524.png[/img]

[b]As you can see on the right side of the screen – there are particular goals that you need to be mindful of when playing through a mission. Those goals can be different and only by fulfilling all of them will you be able to achieve the highest possible rating – 3 stars.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/55f381ff3053212130166f1872a2cb185e8925e8.png[/img]
 
[b]If by some unfortunate accident you will not be able to get all of the goals as in the picture above, where we weren’t able to save one of the currently burning buildings, then you will still be able to finish the mission however not with 3 stars. The other possibilities are of course two stars and one star.[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/9b59d067d440a8fcf391718de5e5a97877b20c84.png[/img]

[b]Of course you can always repeat the mission to try and achieve that perfect score so make yourself comfortable and aim for the highest possible mark![/b] 

[i]It’s all about style… [/i]

Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #34 - ”Fog of War”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Gunslingers! [/h1]

[h2]Have you ever experienced fog so thick that you were unable to see at all and couldn’t believe your own eyes? Well… If not consider yourself lucky as fog can hide many secrets… [/h2]

[b]One of the most important features of Gunslingers & Zombies will be “Fog of War”. Characters you control will be only able to see so far in the distance and anything further away will be covered by ominous fog…  [/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/b9b8c66bfa45f0a4fdafcd2a331dd5700892b8e6.jpg[/img]

[b]You will have to explore by yourself to see whether you’ll be able to find allies and help in that fog or something else completely... As such it always will be an adventure to venture into unknown and you will have to plan carefully for any possibility.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/794abfe96abb92e1b2542eb2a68a40ddb8499778.jpg[/img]
 
[i]After all there are zombies out there... [/i]


Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team
